sloka: हृष्यन्त्यृतुमखं दृष्ट्वा नवं नवमिहागतम् ।ऋतूनां परिवर्त्तेन प्राणिनां प्राणसंक्षय: ॥ २.१०५.२५॥
transliteration: hṛṣyantyṛtumakhaṁ dṛṣṭvā navaṁ navamihāgatam ।ṛtūnāṁ parivarttena prāṇināṁ prāṇasaṁkṣaya: ॥ 2.105.25॥

translations.english: At the advent of each new season men feel delighted to see the newly blossomed flowers and fruits. But with the change of the scasons the life span also diminishes.
